title: BetaTunnelCertificate
description: A CA certificate attached to a tunnel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the certificate, prefixed with `tcrt_`.

tunnel_id.description: ID of the tunnel the certificate is registered against.

fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate's DER encoding.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate expires, or `null` if it does not expire.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was registered.

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was archived. Null if it is still in the trusted set.
